claim_boundary: This artifact extends only low-edge exceptional-average cells through rho<17/90-2mu/3. It proves no high-edge or all-multiplicity extension, full paired norm, endpoint, moment, density, or prime intervals.

multiplier_curvature_theorem.boundary: no high-edge or all-multiplicity extension, full paired norm, endpoint, moment, density, or prime-interval theorem is proved
multiplier_curvature_theorem.edge_ceiling: the derivative and constant terms require respectively j<17/15-4mu-6rho and j<2/3-2mu-2rho
multiplier_curvature_theorem.high_edge_limit: the derivative term grows as j/2 and the constant term as j; order three does not extend the Cycle-138 all-edge ceiling
multiplier_curvature_theorem.regional_extension: the derivative ceiling is positive for rho<17/90-2mu/3, extending beyond 1/6-mu/2 by 1/45-mu/6, which remains positive
multiplier_curvature_theorem.secondary_terms: at rho=17/90-2mu/3 and tau=xi+1/3-rho, the tube, ratio, and constant margins are uniformly positive in the registered range
multiplier_curvature_theorem.specialization: with H=N^2/J and delta=D N^2/S^2, the order-three total terms before edge weight are D^(1/6)H^(3/2), H^2 delta^(1/3), H^2(delta/D)^(1/3), and H
multiplier_curvature_theorem.weighted_terms: after multiplying by J^2 the exponents are 1/10+3rho+j/2, 1/5+14rho/3-2tau/3, 14rho/3-2tau/3, and 2rho+j

remaining_target.statement: control high-edge classes beyond rho=1/6-mu/2 using a multiplicative-energy inverse or a phase-anchored recurrence
